notices.short_title: Civilian Complaint Review Board FY 2027 Regulatory Agenda
notices.plain: The Civilian Complaint Review Board published its regulatory agenda for fiscal year 2027, a list of rules it plans to propose or adopt, in The City Record on April 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: DCWP NOH Self Storage Facilities and Storage Warehouses
notices.plain: The Department of Consumer and Worker Protection will hold a public hearing on May 18, 2026, on proposed rules concerning self storage facilities and storage warehouses.

notices.short_title: On-Call Citywide Electrical Repair & Maintenance Services
notices.plain: The Administration for Children's Services awarded Kemlot Global Associates Inc a $250,000 contract for on-call citywide electrical repair and maintenance, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: Security Scorecard
notices.plain: The Administration for Children's Services awarded Innovee Consulting LLC a $167,135 contract for security scorecard services through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business, without competition.

notices.short_title: In-Person Fuel Training for Ford Vehicles for Citywide Auto Mechanics
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Michael Sanom Communications a $18,750 contract for in-person fuel training for Ford vehicles for citywide auto mechanics.

notices.short_title: TRUCKS, ASPHALT CEMENT DISTRIBUTION
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Gabrielli Truck Sales Ltd. a $5,026,940 contract for asphalt cement distribution trucks, selected through competitive sealed bids in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: Blanket Order for End of FY Computers & Accessories
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded American Computer Consultants Inc a $100,000 blanket order for computers and accessories, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: IT Consulting Services for Enterprise Document Automation (EDA)
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded RCI Technologies Inc a $1.2 million contract for IT consulting services for Enterprise Document Automation, bought through a contract another government already holds.

notices.short_title: PV291-QM2 - Queens Museum Expansion Phase 2
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking bids for construction-related services on the Queens Museum Expansion Phase 2 project, with responses due May 14, 2026, and the lowest qualified bid to win.

notices.short_title: HWCB26KR: REPLACEMENT OF CONCRETE, STEEL FACED AND GRANITE CURBS
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction awarded Tristate Mason LLC a $1.9 million contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to replace concrete, steel-faced and granite curbs.

notices.short_title: BWS Crane Inspector & Rigger Training 6016910X
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded Crane Institute of America LLC a $45,456 contract for crane inspector and rigger training, and the notice lists the selection method only as "Other.

notices.short_title: FMC Architectural & Engineering Consultant 6200006X
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded NY Building Systems Consultant Inc a $1,499,750 contract for architectural and engineering consulting services, chosen through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: SMPD_MATERIALS_PLUMBING (Cap & Coupling)
notices.plain: The New York City Housing Authority is seeking bids for plumbing materials, including caps and couplings, with responses due May 1, 2026, and the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: Orchard Beach Public Address System Design and Installation
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Vinoleo Solution & Services Corporation a $118,129 contract to design and install a public address system at Orchard Beach, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: RE-BID Service Stripes
notices.plain: The Police Department is seeking bids for service stripes, with the lowest qualified bid winning, and responses are due June 10, 2026.

notices.short_title: Derelict Trucks in BK, QN and SI
notices.plain: The Department of Sanitation awarded I-Tow Towing Inc a $1.2 million contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to remove derelict trucks in Brooklyn, Queens and Staten Island.

notices.short_title: Construction Management Services in Connection with the SCA's Mentor Program
notices.plain: The School Construction Authority intends to award a construction management services contract for its Mentor Program, chosen through a Request for Proposals, with responses due April 20, 2026.

notices.short_title: Finance Services in Connection with Financial Statement Audit
notices.plain: The School Construction Authority intends to award a contract for financial services tied to a financial statement audit, chosen through a Request for Proposals, with responses due April 20, 2026.

notices.short_title: FY26 NAQ NYTS - Youth Team Sports (YTS)
notices.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Justice Innovation Inc a $50,000 human services contract for youth team sports, chosen through a negotiated acquisition limited to vendors the city approved in advance.

notices.short_title: Suicide Prevention Supplies
notices.plain: The Department of Correction is seeking public comment on contract awards for suicide prevention supplies, according to a notice published April 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: Bronx Borough President Public Hearing Notice  C 250245 ZMX  1160 Pugsley Avenue Rezoning
notices.plain: The Bronx Borough President will hold a public hearing on April 24, 2026, on a proposed rezoning of 1160 Pugsley Avenue, identified as application C 250245 ZMX.

notices.short_title: FOR LEASES - 1664 Park Avenue
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services will hold a public hearing on Apr. 29, 2026, about a lease for property at 1664 Park Avenue.

notices.short_title: APRIL 23, 2026 MEETING OF THE RENT GUIDELINES BOARD
